name: SIPp
description: SIP protocol testing tool and traffic generator for performance evaluation and protocol conformance testing. Supports XML-based scenario definitions for complex call flows.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Alpine-based and Debian-based Dockerfiles in /docker directory. Build with FULL=1 and DEBUG=1 flags. Community Docker images also available (ctaloi/docker-sipp, sieteunoseis/sipp).

eval_notes: Industry-standard SIP testing tool with 1.1k stars. XML scenario-based traffic generation enables precise control over call flows. Essential for load testing and protocol validation in telecom evaluations. The standard SIP/VoIP load testing tool. Critical for telecom evaluations involving IMS/VoLTE call setup scenarios. XML scenario files enable complex call flows for agentic evaluation.
